name: Tidehopper

bible.movement: Spring-legged shore amphibian that hops out of the way.

anatomy: Exactly two short forelimbs and two enlarged folded hind limbs.
Preserve shoulder/elbow/wrist and hip/knee/ankle/toe chains during motion.
Shell dome, head and eye retain their volume; no shell squash or rubber leg scaling.
Keep the near and far limb identities through takeoff and landing.

clips.idle: Subtle throat breathing and blink; shell and planted feet remain still.
clips.walk: Short hop: crouch, hind-foot push, airborne tuck, forefoot landing and hind-foot recovery.
clips.attack: Short forward body bump with braced hind legs; no invented tongue projectile.
clips.hit: Brief flinch, closed eyes, flexed limbs and return to stance.
clips.death: Legs buckle and belly settles onto ground, eyes close, toes relax; shell does not flip backward.

visualGates: Inspect toes, limb count and rigid joint lengths at full size and game size.
Check shell tile landmarks and barnacle clusters between all poses.
Verify support changes from hind feet to forefeet during the hop.
Confirm cycle closure and cross-clip registration without resizing individual limbs.
Check all directional clips before runtime binding.
